text:
cory: Quick sync - we're finalizing the partner-facing SDK v2 -> v3 sunset. Need final decisions on: 1) single global date vs marketplace offsets, 2) migration kit contents (scripts, CI checks, sample apps), 3) partner opt-in for extended security fixes.

maya: Prefer offsets. Marketplaces + ISVs have very different lead times. suggest: AWS + OEM partners -> +30 days relative to global; others follow global.

luis: Migration kit should include: automated codemod (python & js), sample docker image, CI job YAML, compatibility test vectors (small corpus), and a fallback adapter library (shim). I'll draft codemod by EOD.

rebecca: Communications: plan a single public blog post + partner-targeted notice emails. For marketplaces we need notice windows: Azure/GCP 120 days, AWS 150 days (pre-review). Add note to partner portal with a downloadable .ics for partner AMs.

cory: Good. Also: SI contracts often require 90 days notice for breaking SDK changes. add checkbox to legal review.

maya: For the shim: constraint is we can't carry it forever. propose 6 months of security-only patches, then archived. list this in SLA.

luis: Example migration snippet for server-side token init (JS):
```js
// v2
const {init} = require('redwood-sdk-v2')
init({apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY})
// v3
import {Client} from 'redwood-sdk'
const c = new Client({apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, version: 'v3'})
```

rebecca: Love the snippet. Also add an alerting rule for partners whose listings still show v2 after notice_30. Ops can auto-open a partner outreach ticket.

maya: Timeline proposal CSV (days before global sunset):
announce,120,public blog + partner email
marketplace_notice,90,marketplace-specific listing notice
si_notice,90,contracted SIs notified
notice_30,30,AM escalation + in-portal banner
sunset,0,remove v2 from public listings, block new installs
aws_offset,150,AWS pre-review requires earlier announce

luis: For the codemod, target common breaking patterns: header rename X-RW-User -> X-RW-Client, auth flow changes, response envelope flattening. I'll include a dry-run mode that outputs a file patch.

cory: Who will own the partner roadmap artifact (single-page timeline + asset zip)? need somebody to produce exportable PNG/SVG + zipped migration kit.

maya: I'll own the partner artifact (timeline + portal card). luis will deliver codemod + samples. rebecca will draft emails and AM playbook.

partners-bot: Created event "SDK v2 Sunset - partner rollout" for 2026-04-06 09:00am PT. Attendees: cory, maya, luis, rebecca.

rebecca: Action items recap: maya -> timeline + portal card by Tue; luis -> codemod + sample app by Tue EOD; cory -> confirm legal checkbox and SI notice wording; I'll assemble partner email templates and FAQ.

cory: Thanks team. One last ask: include a small compatibility test runner so partners can quickly validate builds (node + python). can we add that to the kit?

luis: yes, will add a pytest + jest runner with minimal assertions.

maya: Ok locking this plan for the meeting on Tue. :white_check_mark:
